_comment: What of the Google Fonts snapshot reaches the configurator's picker.
The snapshot is everything Google serves; this is the part worth offering
for a dashboard, and the reason each cut is made.
_include_italic: A dashboard reads at a glance and italics cost a slot each; an author who wants one imports the file.
_weights: Thin and ExtraLight disappear at the sizes a board draws.
_maximum_families: Zero keeps every family; the picker searches, so length costs nothing.
